title: Zero modes of non-abelian Dirac operator in topologically non-trivial band insulator
summary: We show that the local gauge-invariance of the quantum geometric tensor (QGT) defined in the two-dimensional Block-momentum (BM) space of a generic $N$-band (arising out of sub-lattice degrees of freedom) insulator represented by a tight-binding hamiltonian, leads to the existence of zero modes of non-abelian Dirac operator in such BM space. These zero modes in the two-dimensional Brillouin zone torus $T^{2}$, determines the probability amplitudes associated with the $N$-component ground state wave-function under adiabatic approximation.
